scope: New ReferencePackStore([plugin]), Pin, plugin.Open and BuildView. Input loaded before measurement. Stopwatch and GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(true), full GC before each iteration. Seven iterations in one fresh process per revision; iteration zero includes JIT/static initialization. Serialize equality checked outside timing.
caching: Runtime shares one Core reference-pack store; assets are validated/read once per store. Repeated GetAsset returns the same AssetContent. Repeats above deliberately recreate the store to measure load work, not the normal cached-document path. Ability/regional views expand lazily.
allocationNote: Core PackFileReader.ReadBounded currently creates an 81920-byte temporary chunk per resource read. The additional 145 images therefore cause temporary cold-load allocations beyond their encoded size. No Core change was made under plugin-only scope.
limitation: Quick stopwatch measurements with JIT and host scheduling noise; not a statistically controlled benchmark. No sample bytes are stored here.
